site_name: Meta Altoona Data Center, 100 Share Way NW, Altoona, IA
year_evidence_quote: Facebook's newest data center in Altoona, Iowa, is now online.
verification: Confirmed at the first check, which opened the cited page. Meta newsroom post dated November 14, 2014 about the Altoona, Iowa data center. Operator statement; year 2014 supported by the publication date plus 'now online'.

lead.year_evidence_quote: Facebook's newest data center in Altoona, Iowa, is now online
lead.notes: Meta's official announcement dated November 14, 2014 states the Altoona data center is now online. This is the first building on the campus. Meta began construction in 2013.

site_name: Microsoft Project Ginger West datacenter campus, 11100 Booneville Rd, West Des Moines, IA

lead.notes: Project Ginger West received planning approval in 2021 for two buildings at this address. Multiple sources list buildings as under construction or recently operational, but no verified opening date found. The 2023 date from Baxtel could not be confirmed from primary sources.

site_name: Microsoft West Des Moines campus (Project Mountain), 8855 Grand Ave, West Des Moines, IA
verification: Cited page is a June 2013 announcement with a forward-looking schedule only; the researcher's 2016 is an inference from it. The page also says 'Microsoft has operated its West Des Moines facility since 2009', which refers to the pre-existing facility with no address. Inference, not verified: the permit name 'Alluvium Data Center' may point to a different Microsoft project (Project Alluvion) than the Project Mountain expansion the researcher matched, so the site match itself is doubtful. Attempts to reach the City of West Des Moines page (403), a Microsoft community page (404) and a Data Center Knowledge archive URL (no article) yielded nothing.

lead.year_evidence_quote: site work was expected to begin later that summer, with construction anticipated in late 2013 and completion by the end of 2015
lead.notes: Project Mountain was announced June 2013 as a $677.6M expansion. Construction expected late 2013 with completion by end of 2015, so inferring 2016 opening. No verified commissioning date found.

site_name: Microsoft West Des Moines data center campus, 550 SE White Crane Rd (Project Alluvium, Willow Creek and Ginger East)
verification: Cited Data Center Knowledge article (byline April 18, 2014) is an announcement only; it states no opening or operating date. The researcher's 2016 is an inference from the announced phasing, which the rules exclude. City of West Des Moines page returned 403, Microsoft local community page 404, Wikipedia gives no opening years. No page opened supports any start year.

lead.year_evidence_quote: Microsoft is building some 1.16 million square feet of new data center space, Iowa officials said Friday
lead.notes: Project Alluvium announced April 2014 as $1.1B campus on 154 acres including Willow Creek Golf Course property. Construction to begin spring 2014. Phased over 4-5 years suggests 2016-2018 for first building. No verified commissioning date found.

site_name: CyrusOne Aurora I / CHI1, 2905 Diehl Rd, Aurora, IL (former CME Group data center)
year_evidence_quote: Construction on the Aurora DC3 facility began in 2009 and CME moved into the facility in 2010.
verification: Confirmed at the first check, which opened the cited page. Page (Databento blog, vendor-authored, dated December 19, 2025) identifies the site as 2905 E. Diehl Road, Aurora, renamed CyrusOne Aurora I after the 2016 sale. The on-page wording joins the two clauses with 'and' rather than the researcher's two sentences, but the substance matches. Caveat: this is a secondary vendor source, not a CME or CyrusOne statement, and 'moved into' is taken as start of operations.

lead.year_evidence_quote: Construction on the Aurora DC3 facility began in 2009. CME moved into the facility in 2010.
lead.notes: CME Group built and opened this facility in 2010 to house its Globex matching engine. CyrusOne acquired it in 2016 in a sale-leaseback transaction for $130M. One source gives August 2010 opening, another says first built 2009.

site_name: Digital Realty Franklin Park campus (Digital Chicago), 9333 W Grand Ave, Franklin Park, IL
verification: Duplicate permit row, found by the session model 2026-11-11. bi:582-0 and bi:1195-0 are the same building: both at 9333 Grand Ave, Franklin Park (Digital Realty ORD12), identical permitted generator capacity (148,750 kW), 199 m apart as geocoded, permit entities 'Digital Grand Avenue, LLC' and 'Digital Ground Avenue LLC'. The site is counted once, on bi:582-0. Earlier verification note: The cited Data Center Knowledge article (June 6, 2012) is an acquisition announcement; its only timing is a forward-looking target ('expected to be delivered and operational by mid-2013'), which is not enough. It also says the three-building property had an existing tenant (the seller), and does not say which building the first phase was in. Digital Realty's ORD12 page (9333 Grand Avenue, 110,000 sq ft) carries no year built or opening date. No opened page states that any building on the campus began operating in 2013 or any other year. A guessed brochure URL returned 404.

lead.year_evidence_quote: is expected to be delivered and operational by mid-2013
lead.notes: Digital Realty acquisition announced June 2012. Article states first phase with six Turn-Key Flex PODs expected operational by mid-2013. This is a projection, not a confirmed opening. Digital Realty bought the campus in 2012; current operator listing shows both Digital Realty and TierPoint.

verification: Confirmed at the first check, which opened the cited page. Meta newsroom post dated April 19, 2012 about the Forest City, North Carolina data center. Page also says Building 1 broke ground in November 2010 and opened today. Operator statement; year 2012 supported.

lead.year_evidence_quote: officially opened today and is online and serving live user traffic
lead.notes: Facebook official announcement April 19, 2012 states the Forest City data center opened that day and is serving live traffic. Construction began 16 months earlier (late 2010/early 2011). Now operates as Meta with multiple buildings on campus.

site_name: QTS Piscataway 1, 101 Possumtown Rd, Piscataway, NJ (former DuPont Fabros NJ1)
year_evidence_quote: Placed the ACC5 Phase II and NJ1 Phase I developments into operations on November 1, 2010.
year_site_match: DuPont Fabros Q4 2010 earnings release (8-K Exhibit 99.1) lists "NJ1 Phase I | Piscataway, NJ | 2010 | 180,000" sq ft with Phase II another 180,000. QTS's June 6, 2016 release says it bought a 360,000 sq ft data center on a 38-acre campus in Piscataway from DuPont Fabros, and QTS's own Piscataway 1 page gives 101 Possumtown Road, 38-acre campus.
verification: Researcher's year 2010 confirmed from a primary source in place of the directory citation (datacentermap, not opened). The operator's SEC-filed earnings release states the in-service date as November 1, 2010 and shows Year Built 2010 in its operating-properties table. The street address is not in the SEC document; the link from NJ1 to 101 Possumtown Rd runs through the QTS acquisition release and QTS's facility page (qtsdatacenters.com redirected to q.com, which served the QTS Piscataway 1 page). The SEC document was located with EDGAR full-text search via WebFetch, not WebSearch.

lead.year_evidence_quote: Nov 2010 - Stage Change DuPont Fabros NJ1 goes into operation
lead.notes: DuPont Fabros opened the first phase of NJ1 in November 2010 per multiple sources. QTS acquired the 360,000 sq ft campus from DuPont Fabros in June 2016 for $125M. DuPont Fabros had built out only the first half of the building at acquisition.

site_name: Amazon (AWS) Hermiston campus, 28803 NW Livestock Rd, Hermiston, OR
verification: The only source is a Baxtel directory listing ("first built in 2022"), which is not evidence, and the record contains no other URL. With WebSearch excluded there was no operator, government or press page to open for this address. Amazon runs several campuses in Umatilla and Morrow counties, so a generic AWS eastern-Oregon statement would not date this one.

lead.notes: Baxtel lists the Hermiston campus as operational, first built in 2022, with four buildings totaling about 968k sq ft on 117 acres. A 2019 article describes tax approval for a new campus, suggesting construction 2019-2021. One permit tracker lists a 2019 permit date. Only one source (Baxtel directory) gives the 2022 first-build date, so confidence is low.
